name: Subway Tile Patterns Beyond the Running Bond
title-tag: Subway Tile Patterns Beyond Running Bond | OC Flooring
meta-description: Stacked, herringbone, vertical, crosshatch: what each subway tile pattern does to a room, what it adds to the labor bill, and which walls can pull it off.
post-summary: January 5, 2027 · The same box of subway tile can read classic, modern, or custom depending on how it is laid — and pattern is one of the cheapest design levers in the room. A tile setter's tour of the layouts beyond running bond: stacked, herringbone, vertical, crosshatch, what each does to the labor bill, and which patterns forgive a wavy wall.
